mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and are metabolized by CYP2D6; tolterodine is a substrate and hydroxychloroquine may inhibit this pathway, increasing tolterodine levels and anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic adverse effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth, cognitive effects); consider dose reduction of tolterodine or use alternative antimuscarinic if excessive effects occur.
